description_en: Grants permissions on resources to users by using a permission template
description_zh: 授予用户权限模板中的资源权限
name: GrantTemplateAuthority

parameters.help_en: The ID of the permission template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of users to which you want to grant permissions on resources by using the permission template
parameters.help_zh: 待授予模板权限的用户ID列表
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The time when the permission expires. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 权限到期时间。时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: expire_date

parameters.help_en: The reason why you want to grant permissions on resources to the users by using the permission template
parameters.help_zh: 为用户授权该权限模板的原因
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Result.description_en: Indicates whether the permissions on resources were granted to the users by using the permission template

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
